intro: The cabinet in the back corner of the arcade has been unplugged since 1987. It still has a high-score table, and the names on it keep changing. Nobody who works here will say who types them, but the regulars all swear it's the same ghost, tapping away at three keys long after closing, when the lights are off and the only sound is the hum of the machines still drinking. The owner keeps a stack of old score sheets beside the change machine, and every so often a fresh one appears on top, written in pencil, with something pressed into the margin that nobody can quite explain.
echo: One up, two up: somebody has to hold the controls.

puzzles.title: Attract Mode
puzzles.flavor: Only the count of each run was kept. Half a turn of the wheel and you'd have it.
